description_en: Query the network diagnosis result of a single Internet of Things card.
description_zh: 查询单张物联网卡的网络诊断结果
name: GetDiagnoseResultForSingleCard

BeginTime.description_en: UNIX timestamp indicating the start time of the network diagnosis. Unit: seconds.
BeginTime.description_zh: 网络诊断的开始时间戳。单位：秒

CardIp.description_en: The IP address of the source IoT card used for network diagnosis.
CardIp.description_zh: 网络诊断的源端卡的IP地址

Destination.description_en: The destination address or domain name for network diagnosis.
Destination.description_zh: 网络诊断目的地址或域名

DestinationType.description_en:
Destination type of the network diagnosis. Valid values:  

IP: indicates that the destination type is an IP address.  

Domain: indicates that the destination type is a domain name.
DestinationType.description_zh:
网路诊断的目的类型。取值：

IP：表示诊断的目的类型是IP类型。

Domain：表示诊断的目的类型是域名类型

Part.description_en:
The name of the diagnosed component. Valid values:

CCIOT: cloud connector.
Card: IoT card.
Terminal: terminal.
Server: server.
Apn: APN
Part.description_zh:
诊断的部件名称。取值：

CCIOT：云连接器。
Card：物联网卡。
Terminal：终端。
Server：服务器。
Apn：APN

Status.description_en:
The status of the diagnostic component. Valid values:

Normal: indicates that the diagnostic status is normal.
Wrong: indicates that the diagnostic status is faulty.
Unknown: indicates that the diagnostic status is unknown
Status.description_zh:
诊断部件的状态。取值：

Normal：表示诊断状态正常。
Wrong：表示诊断状态错误。
Unknown：表示诊断状态未知

SubItems.description_en: The list of diagnostic metrics for the diagnostic component
SubItems.description_zh: 诊断部件的诊断指标列表

items.description_en: A diagnostic metric of the diagnostic component

SubItem.description_en: The diagnostic metric item corresponding to the diagnostic component. For more information, see Supplemental Description of Response Parameters
SubItem.description_zh: 诊断部件对应的诊断指标项，详见 返回参数补充说明

SubItemInfo.description_en: Additional information about the diagnostic metric

SubItemStatus.description_en:
The status of the diagnostic metric. Valid values:

Normal: indicates that the diagnostic status is normal.
Warnning: indicates a warning-level fault in the diagnostic status.
Minor: indicates a minor-level fault in the diagnostic status.
Major: indicates a critical-level fault in the diagnostic status.
Unknown: indicates that the diagnostic status is unknown
SubItemStatus.description_zh:
诊断指标的状态。取值：

Normal：表示诊断状态正常。
Warnning：表示诊断状态为提示级别错误。
Minor: 表示诊断状态为一般级别错误。
Major: 表示诊断状态为严重级别错误。
Unknown：表示诊断状态未知

EndTime.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the network diagnosis ended. Unit: seconds.
EndTime.description_zh: 网络诊断的结束时间戳。单位：秒

ErrorItem.description_en: Metric item corresponding to the diagnosed component. For more information, see Supplementary Description of Response Parameters.
ErrorItem.description_zh: 诊断部件对应的诊断指标项，详见 返回参数补充说明

ErrorLevel.description_en:
Severity level of the diagnosed issue. Valid values:  

Error: indicates a fault.  

Warning: indicates a warning.
ErrorLevel.description_zh:
诊断问题的级别。取值：

Error：表示错误。

Warning：表示警告

ErrorPart.description_en:
Component associated with the diagnosed issue. Valid values:  

CCIOT: indicates an issue with the cloud connector.  

Card: indicates an issue with the IoT SIM card.  

Terminal: indicates an issue with the terminal.  

Server: indicates an issue with the server.  

Apn: indicates an issue with the APN.
ErrorPart.description_zh:
诊断问题的组件。取值：

CCIOT：表示诊断的问题为云连接器的问题。

Card：表示诊断的问题为物联网卡的问题。

Terminal：表示诊断的问题为终端的问题。

Server：表示诊断的问题为服务器的问题。

Apn：表示诊断的问题为APN的问题

ErrorSuggestion.description_en: Suggested resolution for the diagnosed issue.
ErrorSuggestion.example: Please check whether the terminal and card are compatible or whether the terminal can send messages

IccId.description_en: The ID of the source IoT card used for network diagnosis.

Status.description_en:
The status of the network diagnostic task. Valid values:  

success: Indicates that the diagnosis Succeeded.  
failed: Indicates that the diagnosis failed.  
diagnosing: Indicates that the diagnosis is in progress.
Status.description_zh:
网络诊断任务的状态。取值：

success：表示诊断成功。
failed：表示诊断失败。
diagnosing：表示诊断中
